notes: «عن محمد، قال سألت أنس بن مالك» : the asker is the narrator Muhammad, and Anas is the source he asked (rule 5); Anas relays the Prophet's words and ends the chain
«فأنبئت أنها جاءت به أكحل جعدا» is a second, passive report with its own unnamed informant, not a route of the first saying (rule 11: two sayings in one report); not written as a link
